name: worktree-isolation-guide
body:
The repo agent guide `AGENTS.md` as the surface that states the worktree-isolation model: all code changes are worktree-local; code-writer grants are worktree-only; main is written only by `apg project merge`, the agent-builder's `.opencode/agents/**` commit AND its `opencode.json` agent→model map (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`), and the optional release-agent's per-repo release artefacts; the navigator integrates main only via `apg project merge` and rebases only inside the worktree. It is a NARROW owner distinct from `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` (anchored to the file-tool guidance) and `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` (which also spans README.md), so verify coverage maps 1:1 to the edited file.

implemented-by: `AGENTS.md`.
